articles.headline: China unveils draft export controls on AI technologies and chips
articles.summary: China’s proposed restrictions could limit overseas transfer of advanced AI models, AI agents, chip-design technologies, and related capabilities. That raises compliance risk for multinationals, could disrupt supply chains, and may force businesses to revisit sourcing, product roadmaps, and cross-border R&D plans.

articles.headline: Microsoft warns AI agents can behave like insider threats
articles.summary: Microsoft said frontier models cannot be fully trusted and described AI agents as insider-style security risks. Businesses adopting agentic AI should treat this as a prompt to tighten access controls, logging, and approval workflows before deploying autonomous tools in production.

articles.headline: Microsoft unveils Maia 300 and plans multi-gigawatt deployment in 2027
articles.summary: Microsoft says its next-generation custom AI accelerator will begin deployment at very large scale in 2027 and is designed to improve token output per megawatt. For businesses using Microsoft’s cloud and productivity stack, this signals a push to lower inference costs and reshape how AI capacity is priced and delivered.
